starterCode:
# 时间介词值班表
day = 1   # 1具体日期 2月份 3年份 4钟点

hide()
prep = "on"
ex = "on Monday, September 21st"
rule = "具体到某一天（日期+星期）用 on"
if day == 2:
    prep = "in"
    ex = "in September / in winter"
    rule = "月份、季节、年份用 in"
if day == 3:
    prep = "in"
    ex = "in 2026"
    rule = "年份用 in"
if day == 4:
    prep = "at"
    ex = "at 7:00 / at noon / at night"
    rule = "钟点、中午、夜里用 at"
fill_rect(0, 130, 360, 32, "#16a34a")
write("介词：" + prep, 0, 130, "#fff", 16)
fill_rect(0, 76, 360, 42, "#f1f5f9")
write(ex, 0, 76, "#0f172a", 13)
fill_rect(0, 20, 360, 46, "#fef3c7")
write(rule, 0, 20, "#b45309", 11)
write("口诀：in 年 in 月 in 季节，on 具体某一天，at 钟点中午夜", -30, -40, "#dc2626", 11)
write("日期写读用序数词：21st 读 the twenty-first", -30, -70, "#7c3aed", 10)

sections.title: 年月日
sections.body:
【英文顺序：月 + 日 + 年（September 21st, 2026）】
月份首字母大写；日用序数词（1st/2nd/3rd/21st）。
读法：September the twenty-first, twenty twenty-six。
日期前可加 the：September (the) 21st。

sections.title: 星期
sections.body:
【Monday Tuesday Wednesday Thursday Friday Saturday Sunday（首字母大写）】
问星期：What day is it today? —It's Monday.
周末：on weekends（美）/ at weekends（英）。
周一早晨 on Monday morning：具体某天的上下午也用 on。

sections.title: 问时间
sections.body:
【What time is it? / What's the time?】
回答：7:00 读 seven (o'clock)；7:30 读 seven thirty 或 half past seven。
问答日期：What's the date today? —It's September 21st.
区分：What day 问星期，What's the date 问日期。

steps: Monday morning 还是具体某天的时段

mistakes: 日期用基数词（21 读 twenty-one × 应 twenty-first）
in Monday（× 具体某天用 on）
